articles.summary: An organization in PropelAuth can now connect to more than one identity provider. Employees can log in through Okta, contractors through Entra ID, a newly acquired team through Google Workspace, and all of them end up in the same organization. SAML, OIDC, and SCIM are all supported, and each connection is configured and maintained separately.
